description: Delete one stage of your blueprint and every later stage (they are built on it), for good: deleting database also deletes tech_spec and tasks, and deleting tasks deletes the task statuses. To change a stage, save it again with blueprint_put_stage instead: later stages stay. Works after the plan ended too.

instance_id.description: Utility instance id from buy or list_utilities.

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if you have no app sign-in and cannot send a header.

stage.description: Stage name, in order: concept, features, pages, database, tech_spec, tasks.

name: blueprint_delete_stage
title: Delete a blueprint stage
